mapper.select: SELECT CUR_0 AS Sour, CURDEN_0 AS Dest, CHGRAT_0 AS Rate, CHGSTRDAT_0 AS StartDate, LEAD (CHGSTRDAT_0, 1, GETDATE ()) OVER ( PARTITION BY CUR_0, CURDEN_0 ORDER BY CHGSTRDAT_0 ASC ) AS EndDate FROM EXPLOIT.TABCHANGE ORDER BY CHGSTRDAT_0 DESC

WITH rankedData AS ( SELECT CUR_0 AS Sour, CURDEN_0 AS Dest, CHGRAT_0 AS Rate, PERCENT_RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY CUR_0, CURDEN_0 ORDER BY CHGRAT_0 ) AS pctRank FROM EXPLOIT.TABCHANGE WHERE CHGSTRDAT_0 >= CONVERT(datetime, #{Date}, 120) ) SELECT Sour, Dest, AVG(Rate) AS AvgNormalRate FROM rankedData -- Bottom: 0.1 Top 0.9 WHERE pctRank BETWEEN #{Bottom} AND #{Top} GROUP BY Sour, Dest ORDER BY Sour, Dest;

WITH T1 AS ( SELECT CUR_0 AS Sour, CURDEN_0 AS Dest, CHGRAT_0 AS Rate, CHGSTRDAT_0 AS StartDate, LEAD (CHGSTRDAT_0, 1, GETDATE ()) OVER ( PARTITION BY CUR_0, CURDEN_0 ORDER BY CHGSTRDAT_0 ASC ) AS EndDate FROM EXPLOIT.TABCHANGE WHERE CUR_0 = #{Sour} AND CURDEN_0 = #{Dest} ) SELECT * FROM T1 WHERE CONVERT(DATETIME, #{Date}, 120) >= T1.StartDate AND T1.EndDate > CONVERT(datetime, #{Date}, 120)
